# Product Attributes

Part of the **Products** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List product attributes

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes`

Retrieve a paginated list of attributes for a specific product

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `product_id` | integer | Yes | The product ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: attribute, values, creator, values.attributeOption | `attribute,values` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[attribute_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of attribute IDs to filter by |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `sort` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes?include=attribute%2Cvalues&sort=sort&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes?include=attribute%2Cvalues&sort=sort&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes?include=attribute%2Cvalues&sort=sort&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create product attribute

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes`

Create a new attribute for a specific product

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `product_id` | integer | Yes | The product ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `attribute_id` | integer | Yes | The ID of the attribute to link to this product. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `sort` | integer | No | Sort order (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |
| `options` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "attribute_id": 1,
  "sort": 0,
  "options": [
    16
  ]
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "attribute_id": 1,
  "sort": 0,
  "options": [
    16
  ]
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'attribute_id' => 1,
    'sort' => 0,
    'options' => [
      16,
    ],
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/products/{product_id}/attributes"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "attribute_id": 1,
    "sort": 0,
    "options": [
        16,
    ],
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="201" />

